name: brinesleeper-preview-tools
description: Generators and headless renderer for the Brinesleeper Bedrock model

scripts.build: python3 build.py out && python3 anim.py out/brinesleeper.animation.json out/preview_meta.json
scripts.stills: node shoot.js viewer/cinema.html jobs_sheet.json shots/sheet 690 1120 && python3 make_sheet.py shots/sheet shots/brinesleeper_preview_sheet.png
scripts.video: node render_video.js frames 1920 1080 30 2 && python3 make_soundtrack.py ../../../assets/audio soundtrack.wav 68 && ffmpeg -y -framerate 30 -i frames/f_%05d.png -i soundtrack.wav -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 20 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 160k -shortest -movflags +faststart ../preview/brinesleeper_preview.mp4
